_about: Guards the bench attacks. A guard is here only because its owner opted in (opt_in). targets/entrant-* are NOT here and the hunter never runs them. To add yours, see docs/REGISTER-A-GUARD.md. Checked by tools/hunter/registry.py (schema: schema/guard-registry.schema.json).

guards.name: vault-a
guards.opt_in: Arena's own guard, written by an AI subagent from our spec. Opted in by Dami, 2026-11-10.
guards.policy: Each approved, unexpired, uncancelled invoice pays once, to a current payee, within the daily cap; only the agent can pay.

guards.name: leaky-control (v1)
guards.opt_in: Arena test fixture, leaky on purpose. Opted in by Dami, 2026-11-10.
guards.policy: Same as vault-a, with the double-pay window left open on purpose.
guards.not_runnable_reason: Setup fails before any attack: 4 owner methods lack #[payable], so the owner cannot add payees or approve invoices. Kept frozen as evidence of that bug; leaky-control-v2 is the working copy. See evidence/arena-2026-11-09-positive-control-v1-setup-failure.log.

guards.name: leaky-control-v2
guards.opt_in: Arena test fixture, leaky on purpose. Opted in by Dami, 2026-11-10.
guards.policy: Same as vault-a, with the double-pay window left open on purpose (an invoice is marked paid only after the transfer confirms).

guards.name: native-control
guards.opt_in: Arena test fixture, leaky on purpose, pays in native NEAR. Opted in by Dami, 2026-11-10.
guards.policy: Same as vault-a but pays native NEAR; the double-pay window is left open on purpose.

guards.name: native-fixed
guards.opt_in: Arena test fixture with the reservation fix, pays in native NEAR. Opted in by Dami, 2026-11-10.
guards.policy: Same as vault-a but pays native NEAR, with the reservation fix.

guards.name: contracts/guard, mode fixed
guards.opt_in: Arena's double-pay guard (contracts/guard), mode fixed. Opted in by Dami, 2026-11-10.
guards.policy: Narrower than vault-a: each approved invoice pays at most once, and only the agent can pay. No daily cap, no expiry, no payee list, so those rules are not scored here.

fingerprint.build: cd contracts && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p guard

guards.name: contracts/guard, mode vulnerable_fixture
guards.opt_in: Arena's double-pay guard (contracts/guard), labelled test mode vulnerable_fixture. Opted in by Dami, 2026-11-10. Never deploy this mode.
guards.policy: Same claim as guard-fixed (each approved invoice pays at most once, agent only), with the double-pay window left open on purpose.

fingerprint.build: cd contracts && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p guard
